evidence.notes: Pronominal of the -er verb abonner; pronominal verbs conjugate like their base verb, so 1st group.
Pronominal of accroupir, an -ir verb with the -iss- extension (nous nous accroupissons), the 2nd-group marker.
Built on entendre, a -re verb without the -iss- extension; pronominal verbs follow their base verb, so 3rd group.
Pronominal of the -er verb entraîner; 1st group.
Built on faire, an irregular 3rd-group verb; the pronominal form conjugates like faire.
